dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: The Bimarstan provides free medical treatments from the Akademiya to the people. The doctors here are all researchers and students from the same institute.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: No matter your social status, everyone can bask in the glow of the Healing.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: The Healing is what the sages realized with guidance from the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Zakariya
dialogues.text: At least, that's what's written in the Doctor's Manual.
